dropped.title: Failed messages to Decision service are lost
dropped.message: Decision service fails some of what it's sent, and nothing delivers it again: there's no queue or topic in front of it to redeliver.
dropped.rationale: A message that fails where nothing can deliver it again, or that runs out of deliveries with no dead-letter route, is gone. Whether that happens depends on the traffic and the failures a simulation plays, so only playing it shows where, and how many.

findings.title: No timeout on the call to Partner scoring API
findings.message: If it stalls, every thread waits.
